name: pd_incident_create
description: Create an incident on a service; auto-assigns the level-1 on-call of the escalation policy when no assignee is given (POST /incidents)

title.description: A succinct description of the nature, symptoms, cause, or effect of the incident (incident.title).

service_id.description: The ID of the service the incident belongs to (incident.service.id).

urgency.description: The urgency of the incident: high or low. Defaults to high (incident.urgency).

details.description: Additional incident details — the body of the incident (incident.body.details).

escalation_policy_id.description: Delegate the incident to this escalation policy instead of the service's default (incident.escalation_policy.id).

priority_id.description: The ID of the priority to set on the incident, e.g. PPRI001 for P1 (incident.priority.id).

assignee.description: User ID to assign the incident to directly (incident.assignments[].assignee.id). If omitted, the level-1 on-call for the escalation policy is assigned.
